_schema.description: Per-family benchmark spec for .github/workflows/speech-benchmark-desktop.yml. Kept out of YAML so it can be edited without touching the workflow, actionlint-diffed independently, and shared with local runs of scripts/benchmarks/run-family.sh.

fields.cmake_target: Ninja/CMake target(s) to build. Multiple targets space-separated.
fields.bench_kind: 'native' when the engine ships a *-bench binary or a --bench mode that we invoke once and parse the emitted JSON; 'time-wrapped' when we shell-time N invocations of a CLI and take the median wall-clock ourselves.
fields.binary: Path (relative to build/) of the executable to invoke.
fields.source: Where to fetch models from. 's3' (default) uses aws s3 cp against s3://$MODEL_S3_BUCKET/qvac_models_compiled/ggml/<s3_prefix>/<key>. 'huggingface' uses curl against https://huggingface.co/<hf_repo>/resolve/<hf_ref>/<name> — vanilla whisper GGMLs (ggml-tiny.bin etc.) live on HuggingFace, not S3.
fields.s3_prefix: Prefix under s3://$MODEL_S3_BUCKET/qvac_models_compiled/ggml/. All entries in `models` are downloaded to models/<family>/<basename> from this prefix — the intermediate directory segments (dates etc.) are dropped in the local layout.
fields.models: List of files to fetch. Only the trailing filename lands in models/<family>/ — intermediate directory segments (dates etc.) are dropped locally.
fields.hf_repo: HuggingFace repo id (e.g. 'ggerganov/whisper.cpp'). Required when source='huggingface'.
fields.hf_ref: HuggingFace ref (commit SHA) pinned so the download can't silently drift with upstream re-uploads. Required when source='huggingface'.
fields.models_by_size: Only for the whisper family. Object keyed by size ('tiny' / 'base' / 'small'). Each value is either a {name, sha256?} object (source='huggingface') or a list of S3 keys (source='s3'). sha256 is optional; when set the download is verified against it via sha256sum/shasum.
fields.args: Command-line arguments as a JSON array (one element per argv token, so multi-word values stay a single token). Placeholders expanded by run-family.sh per-element: ${MODEL_DIR}, ${MODELS_ROOT}, ${AUDIO_DIR}, ${MODEL_PATH}, and for bench_kind=native also ${RUNS}, ${WARMUP}, ${JSON_OUT}. Native families put the runs/warmup/json-out flags in `args` because their spellings differ (--json-out vs --bench-json, --runs vs --bench-runs).
fields.audio_duration_seconds: Length of the reference input audio (for ASR) or requested output audio (for TTS/music). Used to compute wall-based RTF when the bench binary does not report one. Null when the wall-clock isn't a fair RTF proxy (e.g. TTS with variable-length output).
fields.notes: Free text; surfaced in the summary table's 'notes' column.

whisper.notes: Real ASR wall-time via whisper-cli on jfk.wav (11.0 s). RTF is wall_ms / 11000 — meaningful because the input is fixed-length. -nt suppresses timestamps in transcript output. Vanilla whisper GGMLs live on HuggingFace; hf_ref is the commit whisper-ci.yml pins.

parakeet.notes: parakeet-cli's --bench mode emits inference_ms + rtf_median + backend directly. jfk.wav is a ~11 s fixture; RTF < 1 means faster than real-time. --verbose surfaces the 'parakeet: using <backend>' line the driver falls back to when the JSON doesn't carry a backend field.

sortformer.notes: Diarization mode; RTF divides by the ASR fixture (jfk.wav) duration.

chatterbox.notes: Chatterbox has no dedicated -bench; wall-clock via tts-cli for a fixed 'benchmark run' prompt. Engine is auto-detected from the T3 GGUF metadata. --verbose surfaces the 'using <backend>' line the driver scrapes to fill the Backend column.

supertonic.notes: Native bench: --json-out reports both e2e wall and RTF. --n-gpu-layers 999 means 'all layers on GPU' — on Linux this is a no-op (no GPU compiled into ggml on the hosted-Linux perf build); on the self-hosted macOS runner it flips supertonic-bench onto the Metal backend that GGML_METAL=ON provides.

parler.notes: Native bench; JSON schema matches supertonic-bench. --n-gpu-layers 999 for the macOS Metal path (no-op on Linux without GPU compiled).

cosyvoice.notes: Model-dir mode: bench discovers the six shards under one directory.

audio8.notes: audio8-cli has no --bench flag; wall-clock via time. --verbose surfaces the 'using <backend>' marker. RTF omitted (text-driven variable output).

lavasr.notes: lavasr-bench emits stdout tables but has no --json-out; time-wrapped. No q8_0 in registry — f16 weights only.

acestep.notes: ~5 GB combined; hosted-linux runners may skip if the per-runner disk budget is exceeded. --dur 4 gives a deterministic RTF baseline.

minimax.notes: MODEL_MISSING: no S3 registry path yet. Row emitted, execution skipped. Follow-up: upload MiniMax-Music3 GGUFs.
